explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 60 named tracks, compilations, tapes and catalogue cuts across Resident Advisor's September 11 new-music announcements, official Bandcamp pages for 999RECORDS999, Dedicated Floor and adjacent recommendations, and an overlooked 2025 post-club catalogue branch. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 186's Juno, Mind Medizin, Butter Sessions and Renegade Methodz field was excluded in full; Runs 170–185 were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding; sparse individual evidence is preserved explicitly rather than converted into sonic claims.

Dedicated Floor's two 34-minute tape sides and other inspected items were excluded for continuous-side identity, generic release framing, persistent-state duplication, future-only availability, or lack of a credible lawful boundary test.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 50-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.

sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Resident Advisor's September 11, 2026 round-up surfaced Toronto label 999RECORDS999's September 9 debut compilation of Black electronic producers across North America. https://ra.co/news/86010

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: The official 999RECORDS999 page supplies fourteen exact artist/title identities and durations across a self-described genre-unbound Black electronic sound-system context. https://999records9999.bandcamp.com/album/transmission-999-vol-1

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: The compilation's Bandcamp recommendation trail exposed Koinen's January 2025 post-club release across breaks, footwork, hard drum, juke, IDM and deconstructed-club tags. https://koinen.bandcamp.com/album/moth-flame-and-the-magic-plastic
